summary: Aligos Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 1.01 disclosing a lease amendment for its South San Francisco headquarters. On September 10, 2026, the company entered a First Amendment with landlord Britannia Biotech Gateway Limited Partnership, extending the lease term from March 31, 2027 to March 31, 2034. Base monthly rent escalates from $4.650 to $5.716 per rentable square foot, with a ten-month abatement from April 2027 to January 2028. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present; this is an ordinary real-estate contract.
